Claim requiring proof: Public email/password signup, recovery, resend and verified badge
Specific verification: Create disposable real accounts, test actual SMTP sender, multiple recipient domains, resend/expiry, quotas, secure callback
Fallback/stop rule: Pause open public signup/recovery claims; restricted demo only if owner later approves

Claim requiring proof: Only owner reads/writes private data/source/media
Specific verification: Apply candidate migration to disposable Supabase; anonymous/A/B/operator REST/SQL/Storage adversarial matrix
Fallback/stop rule: Do not launch owner data or public auth until isolation passes

Claim requiring proof: Published HTML and assets remain served during Supabase pause if design promises
Specific verification: Real host prototype, JS-disabled fetch, DB unavailable, immutable asset checks and host policy review
Fallback/stop rule: Do not promise independent public availability; export-first fallback

Claim requiring proof: Immediate owner/admin unpublish is verifiable and direct object URLs do not bypass
Specific verification: CDN cache, edge resolver, direct release URL, race/rollback, 404/410 tests
Fallback/stop rule: Fail closed; do not claim removed; may disable public launch

Claim requiring proof: Custom code cannot navigate, access host origin/data or exfiltrate credentials
Specific verification: Hostile iframe/worker, direct-open, postMessage, CSP and multi-browser matrix
Fallback/stop rule: Static-only Kadmeion publication + independent source export

Claim requiring proof: No path traversal, disguised executable, decompression bomb or unsafe public output
Specific verification: Fuzz import/capture/asset ingestion, MIME magic bytes, rasterize allowed files, size quotas
Fallback/stop rule: Reject unsafe input and preserve existing revision

Claim requiring proof: Staging access blocked after expiry/revoke on actual host
Specific verification: Direct URL, asset URL, cached fetch, token reuse and clock-skew tests
Fallback/stop rule: Do not expose shareable staging until access checks pass

Claim requiring proof: Making a project private does not silently leave it exposed in earlier live release
Specific verification: Private switch + active cross-portfolio references + CDN/direct access tests
Fallback/stop rule: Suspend affected public route until safe new release verified

Claim requiring proof: No spoofed ownership badge, account abuse within selected policy
Specific verification: Signup abuse threat test, rate limits, password reset and verified email claim checks
Fallback/stop rule: Limit public enrollment and disclose inability to guarantee delivery

Claim requiring proof: Exact K vector, Phase B pattern, colors and font licenses
Specific verification: Compare original high-resolution references, obtain font rights, semantic token build
Fallback/stop rule: Keep roles and fallback fonts; do not assert exact family colors

Claim requiring proof: No source/content lost through swaps, restores, invalid grammar, folder crashes
Specific verification: Golden corpus with S0/S1/S2/EMPTY, two tabs/devices, malicious snippets, bytes and hashes
Fallback/stop rule: Use plain managed JSON; reject unsafe operations and export recovery

Claim requiring proof: Identical pinned revision/manifest/assets yields correct public static view
Specific verification: Independent Build Contract repeatability, author-vs-published snapshot differential
Fallback/stop rule: Block publication of unsupported source; label stale differences

Claim requiring proof: Keyboard, pointer, memory, viewport and browsers support full workbench safely
Specific verification: Actual desktop/tablet/zoom/keyboard/screenreader matrix
Fallback/stop rule: Exclude unsupported tablet from editing; allow view/share

Claim requiring proof: Permitted secure ₹0 capture without SSRF or legal/cost violation
Specific verification: Test DNS/redirect/private-IP deny, resource quotas, website constraints and service pricing
Fallback/stop rule: Manual screenshot upload or designed folder cover

Claim requiring proof: Each platform may expose selected public metrics with permitted free rate
Specific verification: Official provider terms/API each, error/429/identity mismatch tests
Fallback/stop rule: Manual handle/profile link, no imported metrics

Claim requiring proof: No telemetry when off; permitted coarse data without persistent visitor IDs
Specific verification: Browser network inspection before/after per-portfolio opt-in; data retention and privacy review
Fallback/stop rule: Keep analytics disabled and P2 feature unavailable

Claim requiring proof: Core auth, project, editor, publish, settings and admin flows meet design goal
Specific verification: Keyboard, SR, zoom 200%, reduced motion, contrast, form feedback, device tests
Fallback/stop rule: Block release of critical inaccessible flow

Claim requiring proof: No paid subscription, card overages or invalid free-host usage
Specific verification: Check current official provider terms, account limits and hard quota controls in real instance
Fallback/stop rule: Disable resource-intensive features and permit portable export

Claim requiring proof: Item 15-day Trash and separate account deletion truthfully enforced
Specific verification: Verify data lineage, active/public copies, provider backups, erasure job logs
Fallback/stop rule: Disclose limits, stop claiming full deletion completion

Claim requiring proof: Composite not shown without sufficient comparable verified source evidence
Specific verification: Fixture metric coverage, algorithm-version, missing-source and fairness tests
Fallback/stop rule: Show categories only, no fake composite
